name: assertify
description: Use websites you're logged in to. The agent connects to mcp.assertify.co, which relays to the Assertify companion on your own computer: the browser and your encrypted logins never leave it. It can browse, read, click and type on those sites as you, with send, post, buy and delete paused for your approval.

interface.shortDescription: Use websites you're logged in to
interface.longDescription: Log in once in a real browser window. The session is saved encrypted on your computer, and Codex can then open that site as you: read pages, click, type, fill in forms, download files and take screenshots. Clicks that send, post, buy, delete or connect wait for your approval. Runs locally with uvx; needs uv installed.
defaultPrompt: Log me in to GitHub with Assertify, then show my open pull requests
Check my Gmail inbox for unread messages from today
Take a screenshot of my dashboard on the site I'm logged in to
